children: UK SaaS retail tech provider's H1 revenue rose to £8.6 mln, recurring revenue reached 86%
Adjusted EBITDA for H1 increased to £1.3 mln, margin improved to 15%
Company returned to profit before tax amid challenging UK retail market
Company says UK retail market remains challenging, with subdued economic growth and cautious investment
Company sees a growing pipeline of prospects, with future sales dependent on conversion in H2
RECURRING REVENUE MODEL - Co said revenue growth and profitability were driven by the strength and stability of its subscription base
SOUTH AMERICA PERFORMANCE - Co said operations in South America delivered a much stronger performance, supporting group results
AI PLATFORM LAUNCH - Co launched itimAIQ during the period, marking a step in its AI plans, though immediate impact not quantified
The stock recently traded at 17 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 22 three months ago
